sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cochrann is the mother of the romantic hero Diarmaid Ua Duibne. One text records a dream of the king. In the dream a woman stayed pregnant for a long time and at last gave birth to a son near a fragrant, singing fruit tree. His druid read the dream. The lady was the River Slaney that ran near Tara. Her child was the harbor at the river's mouth. The singing tree was the king himself.

okr.objective: Cochrann is the mother of Diarmad, who appears through the dream of a king.
